dvids.title: USS Mahan concludes participation in ‘Rendez-vous Naval de Quebec 2026,’ highlighting lethality and U.S.-Canada defense partnership
dvids.desc:
QUEBEC CITY, Canada (July 27, 2026) – The Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Mahan (DDG 72) departed Quebec City on July 27, concluding its participation in the 2026 Rendez-vous Naval de Québec (RVNQ) which took place July 23-26.
